sn4.13:1.1: Evaṃ me sutam ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Maddakucchimhi migadāye || || Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavato pādo sakalikāya khato hoti || bhusā sudam Bhagavato vedanā vattanti sārīrikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā asātā amanāpā || tāsudam Bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāseti avihaññamāno || || Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.13:2.1: Mandiyā nu sesi udāhu kāveyya-matto || atthā nu te sampacurā na santi || eko vivitte sayanāsanamhi || niddāmukho kim idaṃ soppasevā ti || ||
sn4.13:3.1: Na mandiyā sayāmi nāpi kāveyya-matto || atthaṃ sameccāham apetasoko || eko vivitte sayanāsanamhi || sayām-ahaṃ sabbabhūtānukampī ||
sn4.13:4.1: Yesaṃ pi sallam urasi paviṭṭhaṃ || muhuṃ muhuṃ hadayaṃ vedhamānaṃ || te cāpi soppaṃ labhare sasallā || kasmā ahaṃ na supe vītasallo || ||
sn4.13:5.1: Jaggaṃ na saṅke na pi bhemi sottuṃ || rattindivā nānutapanti māmaṃ || hāniṃ na passāmi kuhiñci loke || tasmā supe sabbabhūtānukampīti || ||
sn4.13:6.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || jānāti mam Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti || dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
